hook.en: Spray perfume in one corner of a classroom and soon everyone smells it. Mothballs in your wardrobe slowly disappear without melting. What is happening to the tiny particles inside them?
hook.bm: Sembur minyak wangi di satu sudut kelas dan tidak lama semua orang dapat menghidunya. Ubat gegat dalam almari perlahan-lahan hilang tanpa melebur. Apa yang berlaku kepada zarah halus di dalamnya?

bigIdeas.en: Matter is made of tiny particles (atoms, molecules or ions) that are always moving.
bigIdeas.bm: Jirim terdiri daripada zarah halus (atom, molekul atau ion) yang sentiasa bergerak.

bigIdeas.en: Heating gives particles more kinetic energy and can change the state of matter.
bigIdeas.bm: Pemanasan memberi zarah lebih tenaga kinetik dan boleh mengubah keadaan jirim.

bigIdeas.en: The atomic model developed from Dalton to Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr and Chadwick.
bigIdeas.bm: Model atom berkembang daripada Dalton ke Thomson, Rutherford, Bohr dan Chadwick.

bigIdeas.en: An atom has protons and neutrons in the nucleus, with electrons in shells around it.
bigIdeas.bm: Atom mempunyai proton dan neutron dalam nukleus, dengan elektron dalam petala di sekelilingnya.

bigIdeas.en: Isotopes have the same proton number but different numbers of neutrons.
bigIdeas.bm: Isotop mempunyai nombor proton yang sama tetapi bilangan neutron berbeza.

detail.bm: atom ialah sfera kecil yang tidak boleh dibahagi

detail.en: tiny positive nucleus; atom mostly empty space
detail.bm: nukleus positif yang kecil; atom kebanyakannya ruang kosong

definition.en: Anything that has mass and occupies space.
definition.bm: Apa-apa yang mempunyai jisim dan memenuhi ruang.

definition.en: Movement of particles from high to low concentration.
definition.bm: Pergerakan zarah dari kepekatan tinggi ke rendah.

definition.en: Solid changes directly into gas (e.g. iodine, naphthalene).
definition.bm: Pepejal berubah terus kepada gas (cth. iodin, naftalena).

definition.en: Number of protons in an atom (Z).
Atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons.
definition.bm: Atom unsur yang sama dengan bilangan neutron berbeza.

question.en: Atom X has 11 protons and 12 neutrons. Find its nucleon number, write its symbol and electron arrangement.
question.bm: Atom X mempunyai 11 proton dan 12 neutron. Cari nombor nukleon, tulis simbolnya dan susunan elektron.

steps.en: Proton number Z = 11, so X is sodium (Na).
steps.bm: Nombor proton Z = 11, jadi X ialah natrium (Na).

steps.en: Symbol: ²³₁₁Na (nucleon number on top, proton number below).
steps.bm: Simbol: ²³₁₁Na (nombor nukleon di atas, nombor proton di bawah).

prompt.en: Which observation is evidence that particles are constantly moving?
prompt.bm: Pemerhatian manakah bukti bahawa zarah sentiasa bergerak?

options.en: The smell of durian spreads through the house
options.bm: Bau durian merebak ke seluruh rumah

explanation.en: Diffusion of smell particles shows particles move randomly.
explanation.bm: Resapan zarah bau menunjukkan zarah bergerak secara rawak.

prompt.en: On a heating curve of naphthalene, the temperature stays constant at 80 °C for a while. What is happening?
prompt.bm: Pada lengkung pemanasan naftalena, suhu kekal 80 °C seketika. Apakah yang berlaku?

options.en: It is melting — heat breaks forces between particles
options.bm: Ia melebur — haba memutuskan daya antara zarah

explanation.en: 80 °C is naphthalene's melting point. Heat absorbed overcomes attractive forces, so temperature stays constant.
explanation.bm: 80 °C ialah takat lebur naftalena. Haba diserap untuk mengatasi daya tarikan, jadi suhu kekal.

prompt.en: Iodine crystals turn directly into purple vapour when heated. This change is called ______.
prompt.bm: Hablur iodin bertukar terus menjadi wap ungu apabila dipanaskan. Perubahan ini dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Sublimation: solid → gas without becoming liquid.
explanation.bm: Pemejalwapan: pepejal → gas tanpa menjadi cecair.

prompt.en: Arrange the scientists in the order they developed the atomic model.
prompt.bm: Susun saintis mengikut urutan mereka membangunkan model atom.

explanation.en: Dalton (indivisible atom) → Thomson (electron) → Rutherford (nucleus) → Bohr (shells) → Chadwick (neutron).
explanation.bm: Dalton (atom tidak boleh dibahagi) → Thomson (elektron) → Rutherford (nukleus) → Bohr (petala) → Chadwick (neutron).

prompt.en: Rutherford fired alpha particles at gold foil. Most passed straight through. What did this show?
prompt.bm: Rutherford menembak zarah alfa pada kerajang emas. Kebanyakannya menembusi terus. Apakah yang ditunjukkan?

explanation.en: A few bounced back, showing a tiny dense positive nucleus; most passed through empty space.
explanation.bm: Sebilangan kecil melantun balik, menunjukkan nukleus positif kecil dan tumpat; kebanyakannya melalui ruang kosong.

prompt.en: An atom of chlorine has proton number 17 and nucleon number 35. How many neutrons does it have?
prompt.bm: Atom klorin mempunyai nombor proton 17 dan nombor nukleon 35. Berapakah bilangan neutronnya?

prompt.en: What is the electron arrangement of an atom with proton number 16?
prompt.bm: Apakah susunan elektron atom dengan nombor proton 16?

prompt.en: Match each subatomic particle to its relative charge.
prompt.bm: Padankan setiap zarah subatom dengan cas relatifnya.

explanation.en: Protons and neutrons have relative mass 1; electrons ≈ 1/1840.
explanation.bm: Proton dan neutron mempunyai jisim relatif 1; elektron ≈ 1/1840.

prompt.en: Carbon-12 and carbon-14 are isotopes. They have the same…
prompt.bm: Karbon-12 dan karbon-14 ialah isotop. Kedua-duanya mempunyai…

explanation.en: Same proton number and electron arrangement → same chemical properties. Different neutrons → different mass.
explanation.bm: Nombor proton dan susunan elektron sama → sifat kimia sama. Neutron berbeza → jisim berbeza.

prompt.en: Match each isotope to its use.

explanation.en: Radioisotopes emit radiation that can be detected or used to kill cells.
explanation.bm: Radioisotop memancarkan sinaran yang boleh dikesan atau digunakan untuk membunuh sel.

prompt.en: Why does a gas diffuse faster than a liquid?
prompt.bm: Mengapa gas meresap lebih cepat daripada cecair?

options.en: Gas particles are far apart and move faster in all directions
options.bm: Zarah gas berjauhan dan bergerak lebih laju ke semua arah
Zarah gas mempunyai daya lebih kuat

explanation.en: Weak forces and large spaces let gas particles move quickly and randomly.
explanation.bm: Daya lemah dan ruang besar membolehkan zarah gas bergerak laju dan rawak.
